services.name: ChatGPT, Claude or Other provider
services.detail: The brain you pick (Codex, Claude or OpenCode CLI), on your computer or downloaded from its maker, signed in with your account. Your chats go to it

services.name: The web
services.detail: Pages the agent opens and fetches: public websites only, never your computer or local network

services.name: Tool servers you add
services.detail: MCP servers you or the agent add, and their sign-in pages. Some download themselves, like npm packages. Whoever runs one sees what the agent sends and gets back

services.name: npm
services.detail: Packages for the apps the agent makes

services.name: YouTube
services.detail: Previews of videos the agent shows in chat

credits.name: Claude CLI
credits.detail: Anthropic's coding agent, Claude Code, run as published by Anthropic

credits.name: OpenCode CLI
credits.detail: The open source coding agent, MIT

credits.name: just-bash
credits.detail: The agent's shell, run over its own home folder

requirements.name: Brain
requirements.detail: A ChatGPT, Claude or other provider account (Other provider also has free models)

requirements.name: RAM
requirements.detail: About 500 MB while the browser is on
